findings.finding: Exact raw historical byte hashes precede parsing and fixed-profile derivation. Only an enumerated profile is accepted. Amended bytes use a fixed serialization. Selection replaces only header and both block selectors.

Preparation preserves base and amended bytes separately. validateProfileTemplates independently derives the expected amendment and exact amended bytes, checks row paths/hashes/ids, and never applies caller-supplied amendment operations. Frozen intent joins profile, amendment and both inventories to the prepared packet.

Freeze requires a new destination directory and exclusive writes; original captured rationale files are read/hash-checked and copied. Archived run validates the frozen source inventory before selection, writes new selected inputs and plan, and rechecks input/source identity before each worker.

Worker independently derives the profile from archived pinned base bytes; preparation compares exact amended bytes, execution binds profile/amendment/inventories to intent and compares selected declarations before creating the RPC client. Only localInput/providerInput enter the execution APIs.

Saved adjudication delegates to the archived source closure, validates intent and source inventory, rederives selected declarations from the frozen profile, demands exact selected-plan shape, and binds saved requests to those derived declarations.

Derivation uses only fixed input constants and pinned historical input structure. Previous observed balances/proofs are not read or installed into execution state. Rationale is represented by source path/hash/pointers and explicit selection-bias scope.

limitations: Source review of the profile amendment only; it is not a fresh runtime, preparation, execution, full archive-integrity or security audit.
Root owns the separately run pure controls and preparation. No test pass count is claimed by this review.
